body.message:
Good day, 
My husband and I are looking to rent a premium villa or a spacious townhouse for exactly 4 months, from September 15, 2026, to January 15, 2027.
Our requirements are as follows:
Size: 3–4 Bedrooms.
Amenities: A private swimming pool is mandatory, preferably with a heating system.
Budget: Up to AED 500,000 for the entire 4-month period (All-inclusive short-term / Holiday Home contract including all bills and taxes).
Interior & Quality: We are strictly looking for a property with a stylish, high-end renovation. It is essential that all furniture, textiles, and appliances are in immaculate, mint condition.
We would highly appreciate it if you could share your off-market listings or private inventory that might not be available on public platforms yet.
Looking forward to your best options and photos.

Best regards, Nataly
